points: \item Developed and implemented an automated LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline, assessing model faithfulness and establishing scalable quality gates.
\item Engineered self-correcting RAG systems to specific accuracy standards, ensuring the AI outputs were trustworthy and verifying 'known unknowns'.
\item Built feedback loops into the retrieval workflow (Hybrid Dense + BM25), continuously improving model relevance based on validation signals.
\item Implemented batched query extraction to scale evaluation logic across large datasets, optimizing the assessment of AI quality.
\item Designed anomaly detection systems for verification, creating a reliable framework for identifying and flagging low-confidence outputs.
\item Deployed Python-based evaluation tools on AWS, ensuring that model assessments were integrated into the production lifecycle.
